label: Artwork
help: Pick artwork or upload your own. It's processed on your device - the pixels never leave the browser.

label: Type
help: The physical finish to simulate. Foils and spot UV fill the mask; emboss and deboss raise or sink its edges; soft-touch mattes everything outside the mask.

label: Strength
help: How strongly the finish reads on screen. Preview only - the exported plate is always full-strength ink.

label: Sheen animation
help: Sweep a light band across foil and spot UV, like tilting the sheet. Automatically stilled when you prefer reduced motion; stills never bake a mid-sweep frame.

label: Sweep angle
help: Direction of the foil grain and sheen sweep.

label: Mask from
help: Where the finish goes. Light and dark areas split the artwork by perceptual lightness; By colour matches areas near a chosen colour.

label: Match colour
help: Areas perceptually close to this colour join the mask.

label: Threshold
help: Lightness cut-off for light and dark masks, or match radius for By colour. Ignored for Whole image.

label: Edge softness
help: Feathers the mask edge. 0 is a hard cut - the plate always exports hard-edged either way.

label: Background
help: Fill behind the artwork when it doesn't cover the frame.

label: Plate view (printer-ready)
help: Switch to the deliverable: the finish mask as pure black on white with an overprint label. Send this file to the print house, not the shiny preview.
